==Description==
A [[Wookieepedia:Userboxes|userbox]] template originally created by {{U|Master Jonathan}} for users to display their promoted [[Wookieepedia:Comprehensive articles|Comprehensive articles]].

==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>UserCA|{{Var|article}}|{{Var|formatted name}}}}</code> into your user page.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|article}}}} The article name.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para||{{Var|formatted name}}}} The display name of the article.</li>
#{{Para|oldicon}} A flag to use the [[:File:CA-Icon-old.svg|old Comprehensive article icon]] when set to <code>1</code>.

==Categorization==
*[[:Category:Wookieepedians who have promoted articles to Comprehensive status]]
